t: The Bahco Wood Handsaw 20" (500mm) is a well-balanced saw designed for fast and efficient cross and rip cutting through medium-thick wood materials. Its robust blade features a medium-cut 7tpi tooth pattern that cuts effectively on both the push and pull stroke, helping to speed up cutting tasks. The ergonomic handle provides a comfortable, secure grip and incorporates convenient 45° and 90° marking guides for improved accuracy when laying out cuts.
